scope: Composite educational illustration. Shared anatomy is adapted from a male reference; female HRA organs and uterine arteries are fitted into the assembly. Added vulvar anatomy, perineal muscles, pelvic neurovascular routes, thyroid/parathyroids, six ossicles and representative lymphatic structures are explicitly schematic. The 206-bone inventory includes six schematic ear bones. Shapes and placements are not clinically validated. No complete skin envelope or comprehensive microscopic/branch-level anatomy.
